experiment: Exp B data ladder — data multiplier per architecture (Pythia-160M, SmolLM2-135M) across OWT/C4/RefinedWeb/DCLM, small size only
method: Each architecture trained from scratch on each corpus at the exact B1 8-GPU config (global batch 524288, 8.87B tokens, union neutral eval). Data multiplier = GPU-hours for the arch to reach its OWN OWT-converged neutral-BPB (its best on old data), on OWT vs on the newer corpus (log-hours interpolation, study method). >1 = newer data reaches old-data quality with less compute.
note: Also reported: each arm's converged neutral BPB vs its matched GPT-2 threshold (b160=1.2518 pythia, b135=1.2721 smollm2) — shows the arch CROSSES the GPT-2 bar on RefinedWeb/DCLM though it was censored on OWT/C4.
